name: First Solar
outlook:
What First Solar says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: module sales and adjusted EBITDAFrom a fourth quarter earnings cadence perspective, we anticipate our module sales to be between 4.3 GW and 5.3 GW, including 3.4 GW to 4.3 GW from our U.S. manufacturing operations. These factors are expected to result in forecasted fourth quarter Adjusted EBITDA between $643 million and $843 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
